intructions.title: How to play
intructions.body_1: Help Shaun win by collecting as many stars as possible
intructions.body_2: Use your bouncing baby chick to help you and try to avoid the mud puddles
intructions.body_3: Your chick can hit the ground 3 times, but no more or it's game over
intructions.body_4: Use your arrow keys to catch up with your chick

instruction_panel.title: GET READY TO PLAY
instruction_panel.description: Use arrow keys to control Shaun, Space to jump and throw

lifelost_panel.title: OOPS!
lifelost_panel.copy5: Oh no! Your chick has flown away
lifelost_panel.copy6: Oh no! Your egg has rolled away

tooltip.egg: Be careful not to drop your egg too many times!
tooltip.chick: Be careful not to drop your chick too many times!
